title: Gas Mileage Mentions
summary: This topic combines clear praise for gas or fuel mileage with many non-evaluative fragments that only record mileage or claim-mileage figures.

positive.summary: Positive reviews specifically praise the G70's gas or fuel mileage as excellent, good, solid, or very strong.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly list mileage, claim mileage, or approximate mileage values without stating whether owners view fuel economy favorably or unfavorably.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are non-evaluative mileage records rather than full opinions, which limits insight into how owners feel about fuel economy.
The topic mixes subjective fuel-economy praise with administrative or factual mileage entries, so the cluster is only partly coherent.
Examples are insufficient to describe any detailed differences by country or engine type beyond the observed fragment mix.
